title: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link - A Ritual for Blood 🩸 ~ Palace Medley (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝐆𝐀𝐌𝐄 𝐎𝐕𝐄𝐑

𝐑𝐄𝐓𝐔𝐑𝐍 𝐎𝐅 𝐆𝐀𝐍𝐎𝐍 ❞
ㅤ- Zelda II: The Adventure of Link (1987)



Did a medley arrangement of the Palace (aka Temple) & Great Palace (aka Great Temple) themes from Zelda II: The Adventure of Link. Despite its infamy, Zelda II is one of my favorite entries in the franchise (I love sidescrollers way more than any man should), and its two temple themes have been highlight tracks of the game, so I thought I'd cook this one. Took some clear inspiration both the Smash Melee / Brawl Renditions with elements of the original in there too!!

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay & Background Wind Enabled, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo & WIND Enabled)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay & Background Wind Enabled (LOWER Echo & WIND Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Yoshi SFX (@15)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX
ㅤ3. Decreased Echo Delay & Background Wind Disabled (LOWER Echo & WIND Disabled)
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Yoshi SFX (@15)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. G Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. A Minor (Great Palace Pitch)
ㅤ3. F Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
